description:
Measured from the public causal stream (fz-kdt.34 machinery, HEAD efa05d386,
debug interp, --log-telemetry + replay post-proc):

    00420_enum_take_drop_split: 1,382 AnalyzeActivation evals over 319 distinct
      activations -- 1,063 re-evaluations (77%)
    fz_f98_range_map_converges:   307 over  75 -- 232 re-evaluations (76%)
    enum_predicate_search:        934 over 244 -- 690 re-evaluations (74%)

The worst identity: AnalyzeActivation(main/0, arrow 32) on 00420 runs 83 times
publishing 58 ActivationAnalyzed revisions (25 runs produce NO change). Wake
causes are callee ReturnType facts (fns 66-78, arrows 47/84/98/555/662/671...),
each bumping 3-5x during the ascent. Dispositions: 82 enqueued / 17 coalesced --
coalescing exists but the ascent serializes through the wake loop.

## The two component causes

1. GRANULARITY: a single callee ReturnType bump re-runs the CALLER'S WHOLE BODY
   analysis. The moved input is one callsite; the work is every callsite plus
   full type inference. Callsite-scoped re-analysis (or an incremental body
   analysis that starts from the moved callsite's join point) would cut the
   per-wake cost from O(body) to O(affected cone).
2. ASCENT HEIGHT: refinements cascade multiplicatively up the call chain (leaf
   refines k times -> each dependent caller re-analyzes >= k times -> ...). 58
   published revisions of main's analysis is the ascent made visible. Batching
   pending input movements before re-running (generational coalescing: drain the
   wave, run once) would collapse same-wave refinements into one re-analysis.

~41% of the entire applied-event stream on 00420 is activation re-analysis.
This is the dominant excess-work population and the primary target for
'steps proportional to input'.

Related: fz-463 (CallSiteTargets/CallSiteSummary split -- CallSiteSummary facts
bump 13-14x each here, they are the transmission belt); the downstream-monolith
diagnosis (per-root passes) is the SEPARATE back half of the pipeline.

## Checks
- AnalyzeActivation evals / distinct activations drops materially on all three
  fixtures (pin the measured ratios as the regression gate once improved).
- Output equivalence: canonical BackendProgram byte-identical before/after.
- No new dependency ledger; causality stays derivable from the public stream.
title: AnalyzeActivation runs 4.3x per activation: full-body re-analysis per callee refinement
